starting-the-quest.speaker: Kaqemeex
starting-the-quest.text: What brings you to our holy monument?

options.text: Who are you?

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throughout these lands.

options.text: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?

steps.player: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.

options.text: Yes.
No.
So what's so good about Guthix?

steps.player: So what's so good about Guthix?

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Guthix is the oldest and most powerful god in Gielinor. His existence is vital to this world. He is the god of balance, and nature; he is also a very part of this world.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: He exists in the trees, and the flowers, the water and the rocks. He is everywhere. His purpose is to ensure balance in everything in this world, and as such we worship him.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Some day when your mind achieves enlightenment you will see the true beauty of his power.

options.text: Well, I'll be on my way now.

steps.player: Well, I'll be on my way now.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Goodbye adventurer. I feel we shall meet again.

options.text: I'm in search of a quest.

steps.player: I'm in search of a quest.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Hmm. I think I may have a worthwhile quest for you actually. I don't know if you are familiar with the stone circle south of Varrock or not, but...

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: That used to be OUR stone circle. Unfortunately, many many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adventurer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
Before starting this quest, be aware that your combat level is lower than the recommended level of 10.

options.text: Yes.

steps.player: Okay, I will try and help.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow druid, Sanfew, who is working on the purification ritual. He knows what is required to complete it.

options.text: No.

steps.player: No, that doesn't sound very interesting.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: I will not try and change your mind adventurer. Some day when you have matured you may reconsider your position. We will wait until then.

options.text: Did you build this?

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: What, personally? No, of course I didn't. However, our forefathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.

steps.speaker: Kaqemeex
steps.text: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining, and of those only one is usable by us anymore.

options.text: What about the stone circle full of dark wizards?
I'm in search of a quest
Well, I'll be on my way now.

starting-the-quest-talking-to-kaqemeex-a.speaker: Kaqemeex
starting-the-quest-talking-to-kaqemeex-a.text: Hello again, adventurer. You will need to speak to my fellow druid Sanfew in the village south of here to continue in your quest.

talking-to-sanfew.speaker: Sanfew
talking-to-sanfew.text: What can I do for you young 'un?

options.text: I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.

steps.player: I've been sent to assist you with the ritual to purify the Varrockian stone circle.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, what I'm struggling with right now is the meats needed for the potion to honour Guthix. I need the raw meat of four different animals for it, but not just any old meats will do.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Each meat has to be dipped individually into the Cauldron of Thunder for it to work correctly.

options.text: Where can I find this cauldron?

steps.player: Where can I find this cauldron?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: It is located somewhere in the mysterious underground halls which are located somewhere in the woods just South of here. They are too dangerous for me to go myself however.

options.text: Ok, I'll go do that then.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well thank you very much!

options.text: Actually, I don't need to speak to you.

steps.player: Actually I don't need to speak to you.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, we all make mistakes sometimes.

gathering-the-ingredients.speaker: Sanfew
gathering-the-ingredients.text: Did you bring me the required ingredients for the potion?
If the player doesn't have all four meats:

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Well, let me know when you do young 'un.

options.text: What was I meant to be doing again?

steps.player: What was I meant to be doing again?

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Trouble with your memory eh young 'un? I need the raw meats of four different animals that have been dipped into the Cauldron of Thunder so I can make my potion to honour Guthix.

options.text: Where can I find this cauldron?
Ok, I'll do that then.
I'll get on with it.

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Good, good.

gathering-the-ingredients.text: If the player does have all four meats:

steps.player: Yes, I have all four now!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Thank you so much adventurer! These meats will allow our potion to honour Guthix to be completed, and bring one step closer to reclaiming our stone circle!

steps.speaker: Sanfew
steps.text: Now go and talk to Kaqemeex and he will introduce you to the wonderful world of herblore and potion making!
You dip the raw chicken in the cauldron.
You dip the raw beef in the cauldron.
You dip the raw rat meat in the cauldron.
You dip the raw bear meat in the cauldron.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: I have word from Sanfew that you have been very helpful in assisting him with his preparations for the purification ritual. As promised I will now teach you the ancient arts of Herblore.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Herblore is the skill of working with herbs and other ingredients, to make useful potions and poison.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: First you will need a vial, which can be found or made with the crafting skill.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Then you must gather the herbs needed to make the potion you want.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: You must fill your vial with water and add the ingredients you need. There are normally 2 ingredients to each type of potion.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Bear in mind, you must first clean each herb before you can use it.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: You may also have to grind some ingredients before you can use them. You will need a pestle and mortar in order to do this.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Herbs can be found on the ground, and are also dropped by some monsters when you kill them.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Let's try an example Attack potion: The first ingredient is Guam leaf; the next is Eye of Newt.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Mix these in your water-filled vial, and you will produce an Attack potion. Drink this potion to increase your Attack level.

finishing-up.speaker: Kaqemeex
finishing-up.text: Different potions also require different Herblore levels before you can make them.
